name: predict from the longest matching context, escaping to shorter ones
mechanism: keep symbol counts for every recent context of several lengths; to predict the next symbol use the longest context seen before, and if it has never seen the symbol emit an escape and fall back to a shorter context, feeding the probabilities to an entropy coder

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Prediction by partial matching (PPM)' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossless compression algorithms: an adaptive statistical data compression technique based on context modeling and prediction
